about: How the merchant knows things (Plans/map_play.md: only what you know). 'sure': how sure each way of learning is when learned (0-1); talk loses 'per_hop' for each further mouth. 'half_life_days': how fast each kind of knowledge goes stale (half as sure after this many days; prices: the same month the AI traders use). 'error': the share a told price may be off by (fixed when heard). 'keep': notes older than 'all_days' are thinned to one a month per port, and after 'season_after_years' to one a season. 'words': the sureness at which the map says sure, likely, doubtful (below: stale).
_word: THE WORD ON THE ITEM (Design/research_trade_seasons_and_hints.md 6.1): the one line under a good. The first rule that fires wins: hard news younger than news_days; a price seen younger than seen_days; a price told younger than told_days; talk and rumour, and anything else noted younger than known_days; the season; ships that left for there in the last ahead_days; the law; nothing known. A told price is said as a word, never a number: 'well' when the market pays pays_well times the good's table value or more, 'poorly' at pays_poorly times or less, else 'the usual'. The words themselves are in wording_793.json ('word').
